_comment: waitingWatchdogFailThreshold=1 collapses the production 3-confirmation consensus to a single 5s check so the watchdog fires within the 12s settle window. The watchdog's alive-veto probes (processTree, CPU, spinner, recent PTY data, recent pattern) are still exercised — the 1-strike threshold only shortens the consensus, not the proof. A 3-strike variant is left for the fragmented tests (which tolerate extra transitions) so both consensus cadences are guarded.
